_about: The guides that can be published, by the name in their web address (https://<domain>/<name>/: lower-case words joined by hyphens; once an address is in the LMS it must not change). kit: the kit folder the guide is generated in. steps: that guide's steps file in the kit folder (a chapter or a deconstruction guide gets its own, e.g. steps-part-1.json; all the guides of a kit share the kit's model.glb). part_of: for a chapter, the guide it is cut from. Publish with: python3 tools/publish.py <name> --note "..." (see that file).
